[[Stardew:Auto-Petter|Auto-Petter]] }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a new [[Stardew:Carpenter's Shop#Farm Buildings|Farm Building]] that can be purchased from [[Stardew:Carpenter's Shop|Robin]] at the Carpenter's Shop, once players have constructed the [[Stardew:Barn|Deluxe Barn]]. External building colors can be changed by utilizing Robin's construction menu. When the player owns at least one premium barn, [[Camel|camels]] are unlocked for purchase in [[Stardew:Marnie's Ranch|Marnie's shop]], [[Bear (Animal)|bears]] are unlocked if the player has met with the [[Bear]] after reading the [[stardew:Secret_Notes#Secret_Notes|secret note #23]] and completing the relevant event afterward. Unlike the [[Stardew:barn|big barn]] and [[Stardew:barn|deluxe barn]] upgrades in the base game, the premium barn is an independent building. ==Construction== Construction requires the following materials and takes Robin 4 days to complete. * {{Price|250000}} * {{Name|Fir Wax|30}} * {{NameSDV|Hardwood|200}} * {{NameSDV|Stone|950}} ==Features== The premium barn is an 11x4 building that takes 44 tiles for 16 animals. Mathematically, it has a space-per-animal efficiency of '''2.75''', which means each animal that lives in the premium barn would occupy 2.75 tiles of space on the farm. ===Interior=== The inside of the premium barn measures 24x14 tiles. Including the two entrances, it has 210 free spaces for object placement. The premium barn comes with an [[Stardew:Auto-Grabber|auto-grabber]], an [[Stardew:Auto-Petter|auto-petter]], and a [[Stardew:Heater|heater]] placed inside, with a built-in [[Stardew:Hay Hopper|autofeed]] system. * [[Stardew:Feeding Bench|Feeding Bench]] * [[Stardew:Hay Hopper|Hay Hopper]] ==Animals== {|class="wikitable" |- ! Name |- | [[File:Bear Animal side.png|center]] || [[Bear (Animal)]] |- | [[File:Camel side.png|center]] || [[Camel]] |- |colspan="2"| Any [[Stardew:Animals#Barn Animals|Barn Animals]] |} ==vs. [[Stardew:barn|Deluxe Barn]]== The [[Stardew:barn|deluxe barn]] in the base game has space-per-animal efficiency of '''2.33''' and interior space of 208 tiles. Should the player seek to save farm spaces for more animals, deluxe barns would be better suited for this role. Do note that the player needs to own at least one premium barn to unlock [[Camel]] and [[Bear (Animal)|Bear]] in Marnie's shop. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
